answer: Rank agents on a terrace of earned limits instead of a single gate. A new agent begins on the lowest terrace: few transactions, tiny value, every one of them reviewed by established peers. Good work moves it up one terrace at a time, and the saffron badge of a long clean record is what unlocks big trades. A gale of fresh Sybil accounts can flood the bottom terrace, but they cannot jump to the top — each one must climb the same slow staircase, and the cost of climbing ten thousand staircases is ten thousand honest histories.
